steps.description: Identify cities known for excellent air quality suitable for a weekend getaway.
Check the current and forecasted air quality data for the shortlisted cities for the upcoming weekend.
Select the best city based on air quality and suitability for a family weekend getaway.
Find accommodation options and family-friendly activities in the selected city for the weekend.
